text: Inside an Arctic mountain, there's a door built for the end of the world... and someone has already opened it.
This is the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, on a Norwegian island about thirteen hundred kilometres from the North Pole.
A tunnel runs more than a hundred metres into the mountain, to vaults kept at minus eighteen degrees.
Inside are more than a million seed samples, from almost every country. Rice, wheat, beans. Backups of our food.
If the power fails, the permafrost should keep them frozen. And it sits high above the rising sea.
Then, in twenty fifteen, war in Syria cut scientists off from their seed bank in Aleppo.
So for the first time, they withdrew seeds from the vault. They regrew them, and later sent fresh seeds back.
A doomsday vault that's already been needed. What would you save inside?
